title: Mechanics-on-Demand, Rules Profile, Ability, Equipment & Capability Composition
objective: Add mechanics-on-demand, rules-profile, ability, equipment and capability composition for NPC/creature proposals without replacing owner-domain mechanics, inventory, item, species/form or canonical entity truth.

scope.purpose: Provide bounded rules/mechanics composition for NPC/creature candidates, including ability/equipment/capability projections and rules-profile selection, while preserving all owner-domain authority and unresolved-safe behavior.
scope.completion_gate: An NPC/creature candidate can receive explicit rules/mechanics, ability, equipment and capability proposal composition without duplicating authoritative mechanics or inventory/item/entity ledgers.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 and MNCS_PROGRAM_BACKLOG.json schema 0.2.0 were reconsulted after exact-tree MNCS-08 publication.
The DAG contains no MNCS-08-triggered rotation or newly eligible unfinished interstitial that overrides MNCS strict order; MNCS-10 is the next unfinished surviving tranche.
Owner-domain mechanics, rules profiles, abilities, items/equipment, Species/Form and Character/NPC/Creature truth remain authoritative; MNCS-10 composes proposal/projection layers only.
Mechanics-on-demand cannot silently replace unresolved mechanics with invented values and cannot create a second item/inventory/capability ledger.
MNCS-10 is selected_not_started only; no implementation branch or implementation authority exists until a later owner Continue.
The independent ui-implementation lane remains UISR-06 selected_not_started and is preserved unchanged.
next_action: Wait for the next owner Continue in the product-development lane. On that command, governed-start MNCS-10 with the OPS3 execution guard; do not implement while selected_not_started.

stop_reason.evidence: MNCS-10 is selected_not_started after fresh post-MNCS-08 DAG/backlog reconciliation; no bounded MNCS-10 execution is active.
